item.tib: phur pa'i phyag bzhes me ri bkod legs
item.coloph: de ltar phur pa'i bsdus don nyams len me ri bkod legs zhes bya ba/ bslab pa gsum dang ldan cing sde snod rgya chen po'i don gyis 'khor 'das kyi don ma lus par khong du chud par gyur pa'i gshen gyi drang srong bdud rtsi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba dang / me yi ston pa zhi ba ngang ldan gnyis kyi zhabs kyi rdul spyi bor len cing / theg pa sna tshogs kyi don la blo phyogs pa/ theg pa chen po'i don la sems bskyed par gyur pa'i gshen gyi btsun pa 'a zha blo gros rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba la/ ldong btsun brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan zhes bya bas bskul te sbyar ba rdzogs so//
